purpose: Sequential natural-miss and distractor test; do not reset to correct history after every frame
initialisation: Same first five visible, manually verified detector observations for each method; afterwards update only with its own accepted detections, including mistakes. No label-driven reset or predicted-point insertion.
confidence_only: Accept top candidate if confidence >=0.60 and lead >=0.20 over spatially distinct candidates (>20px). Identical visual rule as v2 override.

known_false_detection.reason: visually verified pitch mark; real ball is partly occluded and has no reliable point label

scope: C1 ends F102, before ambiguous bat-contact F103; C3 F96, C4 F105, C5 F91. All previously labelled visible return frames retained. C5 F86 has no point reference and is unscorable unless later manual review establishes identity.
C2: inspect F58-F86; label clearly visible balls independently of trajectory predictions; only score sequential tracking if at least five reliable seed sightings are available before evaluation frames; never invent hidden release or bounce labels
settings: Use v2 predictor unchanged, fixed 60px search radius and 20px label match radius. No parameter tuning.
status: Further development diagnostic on known clips; not independent held-out validation. Only a local image-motion prior, not a metric simulator.
